Name: A rotten constellation
Author: mistyspring
Description:
[size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41274]1.6 VERSION HERE [LINK][/url][/b][/size]



[size=3]Made for SDV server's 2023 mod jam.[/size]

[size=3]A short story involving junimos, the wizard, and... aliens?[/size]

[size=3]This is a far [/size][i]constellation[/i][size=3], taken over by descomposition and [/size][i]rotting[/i][size=3] debris. After a [/size][i]boom[/i][size=3] catches your attention, you meet a character pleading for your help. You must [/size][i]voyage[/i][size=3] between both realms- and destroy the source of this chaos. [/size]



[size=3]If you're not sure how to advance:[/size]
[size=3][spoiler][/size]
[size=3][list]
[*]Go to the Forest at any time of the day.
[*]Go to the SeedShop / Pierre's
[*]Go to Marnie's
[*]Go to the Saloon
[*]After this you should receive a letter. If you don't, just head over to the wizard's basement + use right warp to reach Vulpecula.
[/list][/spoiler]

Once you've finished all events, two new zones will be unlocked.[/size]
